Type: geometric area rug
Use: anchoring a chair or seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, coastal
Materials: tufted pile, watercolor-dyed yarn
Colors: bright cobalt blue, ivory
Shape: rectangular, bold interlocking zigzag maze stripes with a hand-painted watercolor effect, low pile, medium size
Feel: bold, fresh, energetic
Goes with: dark wood floors, yellow or white furniture, black accents; modern or coastal rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Geometric Rug, 4' x 6', Blue, Ivory
product.description: This beautiful hand-tufted blue and ivory rug will liven up your modern-style room. Spirited color and contemporary geometric patterns will make this a striking focal point for any room in need of a style boost. 4' x 6' Medium pile is easy to clean Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
